newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Banco do Brasil fund has new chief - paper.
newsitem.headline: Banco do Brasil fund has new chief - paper.

text.p: Previ, the employee pension fund of state-owned Banco do Brasil and the country's largest pension fund, has a new president as of today, financial daily Gazeta Mercantil said.
Jair Bilachi, Banco do Brasil's superintendent for the federal district, was named to replace Luiz Augusto de Barros e Vasconcellos, who had been Previ chief for just six months, the paper said.
Bilachi was named Previ chief by bank President Paulo Cesar Ximenes, it said, adding the bank presented Vasconcellos' departure as a routine administrative change.

Previ had a net worth of 17.4 billion reais by the end of 1996's first half, with shareholdings in steelmakers Acesita and CSN, Petroleo Ipiranga, Itausa holding firm and brewer Brahma as well as Banco do Brasil, it added.
